title: UI Preview comment states must share one marker prefix and one table layout
answers: Why does the UI preview comment get duplicated when it is updated?
What rows must the UI Preview PR comment table have in every state?
How is the UI preview comment found for updating
body:
Invariant: Every UI Preview comment body (in-progress from notify, success and failure from finalize) starts with ${COMMENT_MARKER} and has the same rows: URL, Commit, Run. In-progress and failure use `N/A` for URL when no app exists.
Enforced by: ui-preview.yml:finalize (the lookup uses `select(.body | startswith(...COMMENT_MARKER))`) and the notify "Comment on PR"-style body.
What breaks if skipped: a body without the exact marker prefix is not found by the lookup, so a new comment is created instead of updating the old one. Dropping a row makes the states look inconsistent when the comment is patched.
applies: Any edit to the body text or marker of the UI Preview PR comment in .github/workflows/ui-preview.yml.
says: Pull request preview bot posts duplicate comments instead of updating the existing one.
The interface preview comment table displays inconsistent rows between build states.
Update the existing preview comment on pull requests rather than posting repeated comments.
Preview deployment comments create clutter by duplicating on each workflow run.
search: Every UI Preview pull request comment in .github/workflows/ui-preview.yml must begin with ${COMMENT_MARKER} and contain table rows for URL, Commit, and Run. This layout is required across notify and finalize workflow steps so that lookup via select(.body | startswith(...COMMENT_MARKER)) can update existing comments. Missing the prefix creates duplicate comments instead of patching the existing one, while in-progress and failure states place N/A in the URL row. Applies to any modification of UI Preview comment bodies or markers in .github/workflows/ui-preview.yml.
